episodes.title: The Gang Exploits the Mortgage Crisis
episodes.summary: Dennis, Mac, and Frank go into real estate, while Dee sets out to be a surrogate for a wealthy couple. Charlie gets into it with an attorney over the law.

episodes.title: The Gang Hits the Road
episodes.summary: The gang tries to expand their horizons by going on a road trip to the Grand Canyon.

episodes.title: The Great Recession
episodes.summary: With a shantytown taking shape outside, Mac and Dennis try to keep Paddy's going in tough times. Meanwhile, Frank and Dee start a family business.

episodes.title: The Gang Gives Frank an Intervention
episodes.summary: Frank's behavior is more bizarre than usual---so bizarre that even the gang notice---so they decide to stage an intervention.

episodes.title: The Waitress Is Getting Married
episodes.summary: The waitress is getting married, Dee is jealous that she's beating her to the altar, so she tries to derail the wedding.

episodes.title: The World Series Defense
episodes.summary: The gang describes the trials and tribulations they went through, during game five of the World Series, in hopes the judge will clear them of all the citations they received.

episodes.title: The Gang Wrestles for the Troops
episodes.summary: The gang puts together a wrestling show for returning troops. Meanwhile, Dee finally meets the soldier that she has been communicating with over the internet.

episodes.title: Paddy's Pub: Home of the Original Kitten Mittens
episodes.summary: The gang decides to expand their business by developing a number of products that they could sell at Paddy's pub.

episodes.title: Mac and Dennis Break Up
episodes.summary: Mac and Dennis decide that they need to spend some time away from each other. Meanwhile, Charlie helps Dee search for her cat.

episodes.title: The D.E.N.N.I.S. System
episodes.summary: Dennis reveals his foolproof system for seducing any woman to the rest of the gang, but they don't grasp the concept.

episodes.title: Mac and Charlie Write a Movie
episodes.summary: When Dee gets a part in the new M. Night Shyamalan film, Mac and Charlie seize a chance to pitch their movie script.

episodes.title: The Gang Reignites the Rivalry
episodes.summary: After being banned for 10 years from a local drinking competition appropriately named "Flipadelphia," the gang tries to reignite their old rivalry with another local bar.
